'''''Helictochloa''''' is a [[genus]] of [[Eurasia]]n, [[North Africa]]n, and [[North America]]n plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>Romero Zarco, Carlos. 2011.  Candollea 66(1): 96-103</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/100377934 Tropicos, ''Helictochloa'' Romero Zarco ]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Helictochloa%20 Altervista Flora Italiana, genere Helictochloa ] includes photos and distribution maps for several species</ref>

; Species<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=467369 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>
